problem.title: ELO KITTI Odom seq 10 full (1201 frames): the paper's 0.1 m single-vertex BEV
problem.question: Does the paper's ground BEV (0.1 m cells, one closest vertex per cell) instead of the dense profile's 0.2 m running mean change full-sequence accuracy with the fixed Table 6 setting?

variants.label: Dense profile + correction + paper normal patch + forward-bias fixes (fresh reference)
variants.intent: Unchanged Table 6 setting, rerun on the same binary as the candidate.

variants.label: Same + the paper's 0.1 m single-vertex ground BEV
variants.intent: Same setting with --elo-bev-resolution 0.1 --elo-bev-keep-closest (paper Sec. III; the dense profile uses 0.2 m running means). Chosen from the committed 07 window checks.
